installSteps: Import the theme in alacritty.toml under [general] with import = ["~/.config/alacritty/themes/cyclorama-dawn.toml"].
Save alacritty.toml — Alacritty reloads colors live.
author: Real-Fruit-Snacks

themes.name: Cyclorama Dawn
themes.tagline: Matte #050507 dark stage with Beacon Orange focus and Steel Blue secondary accents.
themes.copySnippet:
# Cyclorama Dawn (LX 263 Dark · Beacon Orange) — Alacritty v0.13+ Theme
# Brand: Cyclorama Dawn v2.1.0 | Author: Real-Fruit-Snacks
# Source: https://github.com/Real-Fruit-Snacks/rfs-themes

[colors.primary]
background = "#050507"
foreground = "#F4F5F8"
dim_foreground = "#B3B5C0"
bright_foreground = "#F4F5F8"

[colors.cursor]
text = "#050507"
cursor = "#F06E2B"

[colors.vi_mode_cursor]
text = "#050507"
cursor = "#74B8E8"

[colors.selection]
text = "#F4F5F8"
background = "#3D2B24"

[colors.search.matches]
foreground = "#F4F5F8"
background = "#4A3619"

[colors.search.focused_match]
foreground = "#FFFFFF"
background = "#BD4811"

[colors.hints.start]
foreground = "#FFFFFF"
background = "#BD4811"

[colors.hints.end]
foreground = "#FFFFFF"
background = "#18496B"

[colors.normal]
black = "#0C0C10"
red = "#FF5C6C"
green = "#3DDC97"
yellow = "#FFC247"
blue = "#74B8E8"
magenta = "#C996F5"
cyan = "#56D4E0"
white = "#D6D8E0"

[colors.bright]
black = "#8C8F9D"
red = "#FF9254"
green = "#6CE8B2"
yellow = "#FFD475"
blue = "#99CDF2"
magenta = "#DCB8FA"
cyan = "#85E3EC"
white = "#F4F5F8"
